messages:
alex_chen: Quick preflight check — want a final thumbs-up on GA readiness for Predict: SLA, docs, support rota, monitoring, pricing tiers. owners pls ack by EOD. TL;DR: canary next Tue. @maria_g @kevin_j @sophie_t

maria_g: Acking. SLA draft targets p99 latency <= 250ms for hosted tier and 99.9% availability. Draft is at https://go.redwood/docs/predict/sla (staging). Need legal signoff on the credits/overage clause.

kevin_j: Docs: API reference + quickstarts are in staging. Remaining: examples for streaming and function-calls. Plan to ship by tomorrow AM. @alex_chen can we ship without the streaming examples?

alex_chen: We can ship GA without streaming examples but must call out 'preview' in docs and lock feature-flag. Add a TODO in the changelog.

sophie_t: Support rota: I can cover week1 pager for GA, but need one more primary for US evenings. @kevin_j can you overlap 4-8pm PT during launch week?

kevin_j: I can cover 5-9pm PT Mon-Fri for first week. Will add to oncall schedule. Also need runbook for degraded-model fallback (switch to smaller variant + notify via incident channel).

ops-bot: Automated preflight result: infra capacity check PASSED — 12/12 GPU pools have burst capacity. Canary slot reserved: 2024-04-02T10:00Z.

maria_g: Pricing: tier thresholds updated per last finops sync. Need a short blurb in docs about quota limits and overages. Who writes that? tag: @kevin_j or @alex_chen

alex_chen: I'll draft the quota/overages blurb. Also add sentence on Dedicated migration path / contact sales.

sophie_t: Monitoring: alerts created for token surge, p95/p99 latency, 5xx% > 0.5% over 10m. Dashboard: https://go.redwood/dashboards/predict-ga. Need synthetic smoke every 5m and an SLI on model-quality drift.

kevin_j: Smoke tests will run in CI and during canary. Example command for smoke: ```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"hello"}'
``` will assert 200 + valid json. I'll add the CI job tonight.

alex_chen: :thumbsup: OK. Owners for launch: alex_chen (launch ops), maria_g (SLA/docs/legal), kevin_j (docs/ci/monitoring), sophie_t (support/oncall). If no objections by EOD, consider this greenlight and I'll send the ship announcement to go-live channel.
